model.name: R19.101: In-room tree shows BOTH Members AND Files collections via seed-ior — no regression.
model.description: REGRESSION: consolidating the in-room tree to use seed-ior (R19.90/92) lost the Members collection — only Files render now. Members section is gone from the tree. The Members collection was accepted as missing while files were being fixed, but now must return. FIX: the in-room tree MUST show BOTH Members AND Files as top-level folder nodes (R19.21.A) via the SAME seed-ior data path, WITHOUT regressing the files fix. The Room's children API must return both members[] and files[] as children of the room seed, rendered as two folder-type rb-object-items.
model.tronQuote: > PO relay (Tron): in-room tree LOST Members collection when consolidated to seed-ior (only Files render now; Members section gone).
model.crossRefNote: R19.90 (reuse rb-trace-tree) and R19.92 (same data path as /trace) consolidated the tree but lost Members. R19.21.A (Members+Files as folder nodes) defines the expected structure. R19.101 restores Members alongside Files without regressing.
